title: Correction: 82627B0015-BEDC-KENS-EAST-3 KEC Buildings
agency_path: City of New York > Environmental Protection
description_text:
Construction of a new Screen Chamber, new Police Booth, new Eastview Connection Chamber, rehabilitation of the existing Upper Effluent Chamber, new connecting tunnels, and rehabilitation of existing tunnels, as well as all associated components. KENS-EAST-3 will also construct final site conditions for Kensico and Eastview campuses and conduct the start-up and commissioning of the KEC Tunnel Project. This Competitive Sealed Bid (RFx') is being released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal Navigator at https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the RFx, insert the EPIN 82627B0015 into the Keywords search field. If you need assistance submitting a response, please contact MOCS Service Desk: mocssupport.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/8

Pre bid conference location - Microsoft TEAMS. Interested attendees must complete and submit their NDA for approval. Once approved, access to the NDA OneDrive folder will be granted.
